title: Challenging Weather and Siding: How LP® SmartSide® Products Help Protect Homes from the Elements
summary: Discover how LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products are engineered to help protect homes from weather including moisture, hail, humidity, and extreme temperature changes.
body_markdown:
From powerful storms to extreme heat and freezing temperatures, weather can put your home’s exterior to the test. The siding on your home serves as the first line of defense against these elements, helping protect your home’s structure while maintaining curb appeal.


When challenging weather strikes, not all siding products perform the same. That’s why many homeowners, builders, and contractors look for exterior products designed to withstand the challenges of their local climate.


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products are engineered to deliver durability, beauty, and long-term performance, helping homeowners face unpredictable weather with confidence.


**How Harsh Weather Impacts a Home’s Exterior**


**Heavy Rain and Moisture**


Moisture is one of the most persistent threats to a home’s exterior. Over time, excessive exposure to rain and humidity can contribute to:


-


Swelling and warping


-


Fungal decay


-


Mold and mildew growth


-


Water infiltration damage


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products feature the proprietary SmartGuard® treatment process, which helps protect against fungal decay and termite damage while enhancing long-term durability. This added layer of protection can be especially valuable in regions that experience frequent rainfall or high humidity.


**Challenging Storms**


Strong storms can challenge siding systems with powerful gusts and wind-driven rain. Loose or damaged siding can allow moisture to penetrate the building envelope and create larger issues.


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products are engineered for toughness and can withstand hail damage and weather exposure that often accompanies challenging storms. Our lap siding is designed to withstand tough storms with wind gusts of up to 200 mph*. This durability gives homeowners added confidence when weather conditions become unpredictable.


*See APA PR-N124 or ESR 1301


**Hail and Impact Resistance**


Hailstorms can leave dents, cracks, and visible damage on many exterior materials. Even minor damage can create opportunities for moisture intrusions, leading to major repairs in the future.


For homeowners in regions prone to hail storms, hail-resistant siding can play an important role in protecting your home’s exterior investment.


The LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding prorated, limited warranty offers protection against damage from hail up to 1.75” in diameter, helping homeowners maintain both the appearance and performance of their exterior.


Refer to limited warranty at lpcorp.com/literature for complete details, including important limitations and exclusions.


**Extreme Temperature and Seasonal Changes**


Whether it’s summer heat or winter freeze-thaw cycles, temperature swings impact a home’s exterior. Expansion and contraction caused by fluctuating temperatures may contribute to cracking, splitting, or separation in some siding products.


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding is designed to perform across a variety of climates and weather conditions. Homeowners can achieve the classic look of traditional wood siding while benefiting from engineered durability that helps stand up to changing environmental conditions.


**Why LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding Is Built for Tough Conditions**


When evaluating siding options for challenging weather, several features make LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding stand out.


-


**Engineered for Durability**


-


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products are manufactured using engineered wood technology to provide long-lasting performance and resistance to everyday wear and tear.


-


**LP® SmartGuard® Protection**


-


The SmartGuard® manufacturing process combines engineered wood strands with waxes, resins, and zinc borate to help resist:


-


Moisture-related damage


-


Fungal decay


-


Termite damage


-


**Authentic Wood Appearance**


-


Harsh weather performance doesn’t mean sacrificing curb appeal. LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products provide the warmth and beauty of traditional wood while delivering enhanced durability and resiliency.


-


**Long-Term Warranty Protection**


-


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products are backed by an industry-leading 5/50-year prorated limited warranty, so homeowners have confidence in their investment. Refer to limited warranty at lpcorp.com/literature for complete details, including important limitations and exclusions.


**Looking Beyond Siding: Building a More Resilient Home**


A weather resistant exterior starts with more than siding alone. For homeowners building a new home or remodeling an existing home, a complete exterior system can provide additional protection.


**LP WeatherLogic® Air & Water Barrier**


Designed to help manage air and water moisture, LP WeatherLogic® Air & Water Barrier provides a secondary layer of defense behind the exterior siding. When combined with quality siding, it can help create a more durable building envelope.


**LP® FlameBlock® Fire-Rated Sheathing**


In regions where wildfire risks are a concern, LP® FlameBlock® Fire-Rated Sheathing offers additional peace of mind. It provides fire-resistant protection while maintaining the structural performance builders expect.


**Invest in Siding Designed for Challenging Weather**


Challenging weather is inevitable, but costly exterior damage doesn't have to be. Choosing durable products designed to withstand moisture and temperature extremes can help protect your home for years to come.


LP® SmartSide® Trim & Siding products, combined with solutions like LP WeatherLogic® Air & Water Barrier and LP® FlameBlock® Fire-Rated Sheathing, provide homeowners with an exterior system engineered to help stand up to nature's toughest conditions.
